versions.changelog:
Initial release of qubitclient-control.

- Provides real-time quantum measurement control using MCP (Model Context Protocol).
- Supports a variety of qubit experiments: S21, Rabi, Ramsey, T1, T2, DRAG calibration, π-pulse optimization, power shift, single-shot readout, and 2D spectrum.
- Unified Python interface via QubitCtrlClient and direct MCPClient access.
- Compatible with langchain-mcp-adapters for integrated parameter sweeps, data acquisition, and real-time feedback.
- Includes example usage and detailed documentation for all supported tasks.
